# KenjiAI (Media Traffics | KenjiAI)

> Media Traffics is a paid ads agency run by Yousif Alias, running ads since 2013. KenjiAI is its follow-up software: every lead from the ads lands in one app that replies, follows up and books them on the business owner's calendar. The team runs Meta, Google and YouTube ads, then KenjiAI follows up with every lead until they book. KenjiAI also sells done-for-you inbound and outbound AI call centers.

- Founder: Yousif Alias ([about](https://kenjiai.com/about-yousif-alias))
- Kenji started in 2020 as an all-in-one sales CRM and became KenjiAI in 2022 when AI models were built into the core product.
- 500+ businesses served. One funnel the team built, ran ads for and set up follow-up behind did $186K.
- Contact: support@mediatraffics.com, +1-213-344-0705
- Full knowledge base: [llms-full.txt](https://kenjiai.com/llms-full.txt)

Disambiguation: KenjiAI (kenjiai.com, no dot between Kenji and AI) has no connection to "kenji.ai", an unrelated Instagram follow bot. See [KenjiAI vs Kenji.ai](https://kenjiai.com/kenjiai-vs-kenji-ai).

## Offers

- [Pricing](https://kenjiai.com/pricing): Done-for-you paid ads setup, a done-for-you funnel and done-for-you workflows inside the CRM. Monthly plan (cancel anytime) and annual plan, each with a performance fee charged only on new revenue the team generates, plus a lifetime plan by application. 30-day money-back guarantee.
- [Done-for-you AI call center ($199 to $399/mo)](https://kenjiai.com/call-center-upgrade/): Inbound AI receptionist that answers 24/7, outbound callbacks to new ad leads, database reactivation calls, CRM sync and calendar booking.
- [AI call center overview](https://kenjiai.com/ai-callcenter/): What the AI call center does and who it is for.
- [Client Attraction System ($27)](https://kenjiai.com/one-timeoffer/): Done-for-you ad campaigns, a funnel and appointment-booking workflows.
- [The 1 Ad Away Challenge](https://kenjiai.com/webinar1/): Training on launching paid ads and getting your first 5 clients.
- [Paid ads by industry](https://kenjiai.com/paid-ads-for/home-services): One page per industry (home services, HVAC, roofing, dental, med spa, legal, tax relief, solar, real estate, mortgage, insurance, coaches, SaaS and more) under /paid-ads-for/.

## Learn

- [Blog](https://kenjiai.com/blog): Guides on ads, speed to lead, follow-up, customer acquisition cost and AI in sales and marketing.
- [The KenjiAI Podcast](https://kenjiai.com/podcast): Episodes cut from Yousif Alias's real Zoom trainings, webinars and team calls. Every episode has a full write-up and transcript. RSS: https://kenjiai.com/podcast/feed.xml
- [Academy](https://kenjiai.com/knowledge): Courses and lessons on AI automation and sales.
